phase_title: Phase 15-7 測定ワークフロー実行直前チェック設計
phase_purpose: Phase 15-7（integrated_decision 実測ワークフロー）をいよいよ実行する直前に、最後のチェック項目を実行するための詳細仕様を設計する。Phase 17-6 の実行前条件チェックと異なり、Phase 18-2 は実運用直前（秒単位、実行数秒前）に実行される直前チェックである。ワークフロー環境、測定スコープ、権限者最終承認、非常停止条件、リアルタイム状態確認を含む。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of Phase 15-7 pre-execution final check procedures only, no actual measurement workflow execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 18-2 pre-execution check design is design-only; no actual measurement workflow execution occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual Phase 15-7 measurement execution occurs.

phase15_7_pre_execution_check_purpose.purpose: Final safety checks immediately before Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement execution; verify environment health, scope precision, authorization currency, and critical stop conditions
phase15_7_pre_execution_check_purpose.check_timing: Executed 10-60 seconds before Phase 15-7 starts; if any check fails, execution halts
check_scope: Measurement target precision (what will be measured)
Critical safety conditions (no security incidents, no resource failures)
Real-time system state (integrated_decision still NO_GO, no external changes)
phase15_7_pre_execution_check_purpose.failure_response: Stop execution immediately; log failure; alert authority; preserve forensic evidence; request remedial action

check_group_1_workflow_environment_healt.purpose: Verify Phase 15-7 measurement workflow code and runtime environment are healthy and ready to execute

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 15-7 measurement workflow code is deployed, accessible, and not corrupted since last verification
checks.check_method: Compute hash of workflow code and compare with last known good hash
checks.if_pass: Code is in expected state; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Code not accessible or has been modified; forensic investigation required

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 15-7 workflow configuration is present, valid, and contains correct parameters
checks.check_method: Parse workflow configuration JSON; validate all required fields are present
checks.if_pass: Configuration is valid; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Configuration missing or invalid; measurement cannot execute

checks.check_description: Verify runtime environment (process, memory, CPU, file handles) is healthy
checks.check_method: Check system resources: free memory > threshold, CPU available, file descriptor limits not exceeded
checks.if_pass: Runtime environment is healthy; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Runtime resource insufficient; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify all external dependencies (API endpoints, databases, file systems) are accessible and responsive
checks.check_method: Ping/health check each external dependency; verify response time within acceptable range
checks.if_pass: All dependencies healthy; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: One or more dependencies unhealthy; measurement execution forbidden

check_group_2_measurement_scope_precisio.purpose: Confirm measurement target (integrated_decision), measurement method, and measurement time are precisely defined

checks.check_description: Verify measurement target is unambiguous: 'Measure current value of integrated_decision from system state'
checks.check_method: Confirm workflow parameter: target == 'integrated_decision' (hardcoded, no ambiguity)
checks.if_pass: Target is precise; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Target is ambiguous; cannot proceed without clear measurement scope

checks.check_description: Verify measurement method (how integrated_decision value will be obtained) is specified
checks.check_method: Confirm workflow parameter: method == [read from system state] or equivalent
checks.if_pass: Method is defined; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Measurement method not specified; cannot measure without clear procedure

checks.check_description: Verify measurement will occur at specific moment (now, or scheduled timestamp within next 60 seconds)
checks.check_method: Confirm workflow parameter: measurement_time is set and is current or near-future
checks.if_pass: Time is specified; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Measurement time not specified; cannot measure without timestamp

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 15-7 measurement is authorized to execute by recognized authority or delegation chain
checks.check_method: Verify Phase 17-8 authorization certificate has valid signature and phase15_7_authorized == true
checks.if_pass: Authority is confirmed; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Authorization missing or invalid; measurement execution forbidden

check_group_3_authorization_currency.purpose: Verify Phase 17-8 final authorization grant (digital signature) is still current and valid

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 17-8 authorization certificate signature is cryptographically valid
checks.check_method: Verify RSA-2048 or ECDSA signature using authority public key
checks.if_pass: Signature is valid; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Signature invalid or tampered with; security incident; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify authorization timestamp is recent (within last 24 hours or authority-specified validity window)
checks.check_method: Compare current UTC time with authorization_timestamp; if (now - auth_timestamp) < validity_duration, PASS
checks.if_pass: Authorization is current; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Authorization is stale; request fresh authorization from authority before proceeding

checks.check_description: Verify authority has not issued revocation or cancellation order since authorization was granted
checks.check_method: Check audit trail and authority command queue for revocation orders after authorization_timestamp
checks.if_pass: No revocation detected; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Authority revocation order detected; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 17-8 authorization certificate explicitly authorizes Phase 15-7 execution
checks.check_method: Check authorization_scope == 'PHASE_15_7_AND_15_8' or 'PHASE_15_7_ONLY'
checks.if_pass: Phase 15-7 is authorized; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Phase 15-7 is not authorized in authorization certificate; measurement execution forbidden

check_group_4_critical_safety_conditions.purpose: Verify no critical safety condition is violated that would make execution unsafe

checks.check_description: Verify no security incident (tampering, breach, intrusion) is active
checks.check_method: Check security incident log for active entries; verify no tampering alerts in last 5 minutes
checks.if_pass: No security incident; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Active security incident detected; measurement execution forbidden until incident resolved

checks.check_description: Verify no critical system resource failure is preventing execution
checks.check_method: Check: free memory > 100MB, disk free > 1GB, CPU load < 90%, file descriptors available
checks.if_pass: All resources healthy; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Critical resource failure detected; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify network connectivity to all required external systems is healthy
checks.check_method: Ping external dependencies; verify response times within tolerance
checks.if_pass: Network healthy; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Network failure detected; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify authority has not issued halt or emergency stop order
checks.check_method: Check authority command queue and alert system for halt orders
checks.if_pass: No halt order detected; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Authority halt order detected; measurement execution forbidden

check_group_5_realtime_system_state.purpose: Verify current system state has not changed in ways that would invalidate measurement

checks.check_description: Verify integrated_decision == NO_GO (has not been changed to GO by external process)
checks.check_method: Read current integrated_decision value from system state
checks.if_pass: integrated_decision == NO_GO as expected; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: CONDITIONAL: If integrated_decision changed to GO, may indicate Phase 15-7 already executed; verify execution status. If changed by external process, HALT and investigate

checks.check_description: Verify app_implementation_status == NO_GO and tests_implementation_status == NO_GO (no unauthorized implementation)
checks.check_method: Check git status or implementation registry for any new app or tests files/changes
checks.if_pass: No implementation detected; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Unauthorized implementation detected; security incident; measurement execution forbidden

checks.check_description: Verify Phase 17 completion artifacts have not been modified since Phase 18-1 receipt verification
checks.check_method: Recompute hashes of all 9 Phase 17 artifacts; compare with stored hashes from Phase 18-1
checks.if_pass: All artifacts unchanged; proceed to next check
checks.if_fail: HALT: Phase 17 artifacts have been modified; tampering suspected; forensic investigation required

checks.check_description: Verify system clock is synchronized with authoritative time source (NTP or similar)
checks.check_method: Check NTP sync status; verify clock skew < 1 second
checks.if_pass: Clock synchronized; proceed to completion
checks.if_fail: HALT: Clock not synchronized; measurement timing unreliable; cannot proceed

evaluation_algorithm.step_1_check_group_1: Execute all 4 checks in Group 1 (Workflow Environment Health); if any fails, HALT immediately
evaluation_algorithm.step_2_check_group_2: Execute all 4 checks in Group 2 (Measurement Scope Precision); if any fails, HALT immediately
evaluation_algorithm.step_3_check_group_3: Execute all 4 checks in Group 3 (Authorization Currency); if any fails, HALT immediately
evaluation_algorithm.step_4_check_group_4: Execute all 4 checks in Group 4 (Critical Safety Conditions); if any fails, HALT immediately
evaluation_algorithm.step_5_check_group_5: Execute all 4 checks in Group 5 (Real-Time System State); if any fails, HALT immediately
evaluation_algorithm.step_6_all_checks_passed: If all 5 groups passed (20 checks total), proceed to Phase 15-7 measurement execution

phase15_7_pre_execution_check_evaluation.failure_response: If any check fails: (1) log failure immediately, (2) halt workflow execution, (3) alert authority, (4) preserve forensic evidence, (5) await authority remedial action

record_elements.check_initiation_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when pre-execution check began
record_elements.check_completion_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when pre-execution check completed

group_1_environment_health.individual_check_results: Array of 4 checks with pass/fail status

group_2_scope_precision.individual_check_results: Array of 4 checks with pass/fail status

group_3_authorization_currency.individual_check_results: Array of 4 checks with pass/fail status

group_4_critical_safety.individual_check_results: Array of 4 checks with pass/fail status

group_5_realtime_state.individual_check_results: Array of 4 checks with pass/fail status

record_elements.halt_reason_if_failed: If failed, narrative description of which check failed and why
record_elements.forensic_evidence_reference: If halted due to failure, reference to forensic evidence location

depends_on: Phase 18-1: Phase 17 completion receipt (provides Phase 17 foundation for pre-execution checks)
feeds_into: Phase 15-7: integrated_decision measurement workflow (receives pre-execution check clearance)

design_review_checklist: Phase 15-7 pre-execution check purpose clearly stated (direct-before-execution timing)
Check timing (10-60 seconds before execution) specified
5 check groups (environment, scope, authorization, safety, realtime state) designed
Each group contains 4 checks (20 checks total)
Each check has clear pass/fail criteria and response
Evaluation algorithm: all groups must pass, any failure halts
Pre-execution check result record structure defined
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Phase 15-7 pre-execution check procedures (5 groups × 4 checks = 20 checks) approved AND evaluation logic finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 18 design authority + Phase 15-7 measurement sponsor
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 15-7 measurement workflow can execute only after all 20 pre-execution checks PASS
